title: Fix boundary handling for non-multiple-of-tile GEMM dims (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
6x6 x 6x6 GEMM tiled 4x4 -- every dimension is ragged (not a multiple of the tile size).
Scratch memory just past A/B/C's real extent is poisoned with a large nonzero constant, so an unguarded out-of-bounds load fails visibly instead of getting lucky with a zero.
